faqs.question: How often should I schedule mosquito treatments in Kew Gardens?

faqs.question: Are your mosquito control treatments safe for my family and pets?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We use EPA-registered products that are safe for families and pets when applied by a Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator.
